reason: Semantics hold on every path. widen_by_live tail: the y1 and y2 updates are independent (list_y1 in ren_vars_d at REN_BASE+&A80+, list_y2 in ren_vars_h0 at REN_BASE+&4C8, separate MOVER_SLOTS+1 arrays, no aliasing), so swapping their order changes no memory result; BCS y1_kept (keep when A>=mem) becomes BCC store (store when A<mem), the same condition. Only entry is JSR widen_by_live (render.6502:1083); y1_kept/y2_kept/x2_kept are scoped and referenced nowhere else. Exit: X and Y (=MOVER_SLOTS) unchanged, stack the same; A and C differ (old A=list_y2,Y, new A=list_y1+MOVER_SLOTS; C differs) but both are dead: the caller goes to .listed INC list_n, LDY ren_k, INY, BRA gather, whose CPY act_n sets C before TXA/ADC and LDA rec_xh overwrites A; the BEQ gathered exit has C=1 from CPY. take_off: BPL out (out = bare RTS) becomes BMI go / RTS, identical A/X/Y/flags/stack at the early exit; the other BEQ out still reaches .out's RTS; callers (render.6502:478, 486) are unchanged either way. No IRQ involvement: list_* and need are renderer workspace written and read only by the main-loop renderer, and the store order swap is invisible to irq1_handler. Shifting later code by +2 is resolved by the one assembly (labels, SMC operands like mark_part.header_lo are symbolic); branch ranges and ASSERT render_end<=REN_BASE are checked at build. Cycles: common path (y1 kept, y2 stored) old 32 -> new 31; rare y1-stored path +1; take_off not-taken path BPL taken(3, +1 if it crossed a page)+RTS -> BMI not taken(2)+RTS, -1. Bytes: grows by 2 (one RTS each), matching the claim's -2.
